title: SPIELBERG — PACT protocol demo script + recording for April 14 launch
description: April 14 Godman launch needs a 60-second terminal demo showing PACT protocol: mandate creation, signing, and verification. Spielberg scaffold (scripts/spielberg/) is production-ready from Sprint 957. Create scripts/spielberg/pact-demo.json and run the orchestrator to produce workspace/scs001/code-demo-runs/pact-demo/ with recording + post-produced mp4.

tasks.title: Create scripts/spielberg/pact-demo.json — 6-scene PACT demo
tasks.description: Create scripts/spielberg/pact-demo.json. Scenes: (1) clear + title banner 'PACT Protocol — Mandate Lifecycle Demo', (2) 'npm install @godman-protocols/pact', (3) 'node -e require code to createMandate', (4) output showing mandate hash, (5) 'verifyMandate' call showing VERIFIED, (6) success banner. Use theme=monokai, cols=80, rows=24. Total duration ~60s. Caption each scene for post-production overlay.

tasks.title: Run Spielberg orchestrator on pact-demo.json
tasks.description: Run: npx ts-node scripts/spielberg/index.ts scripts/spielberg/pact-demo.json. Verify output in workspace/scs001/code-demo-runs/pact-demo/: recording.cast + demo.mp4. Report file sizes and duration. If asciinema not installed, note it and skip.
